_meta.indication: Adult patients with unresectable or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC whose tumors have HER2 (ERBB2) tyrosine kinase domain activating mutations, as detected by an FDA-approved test, and who have received prior systemic therapy

pivotal_trials.phase: Phase Ib portion of Beamion LUNG-1 (dose-expansion part), which was the registrational portion of the Phase I trial
pivotal_trials.design: Non-randomized, open-label, single-arm, multi-center, multi-cohort trial
pivotal_trials.population: 71 patients with unresectable or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC with HER2 (ERBB2) TKD mutations who had received at least one line of prior systemic therapy (all had prior platinum-based chemotherapy)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Objective response rate (ORR) and duration of response (DOR) per RECIST v1.1 by blinded independent central review
pivotal_trials.result: ORR 75% (95% CI: 63, 83); complete response 6%, partial response 69%; DOR analysis population N=53; 58% of responders had an observed DOR ≥ 6 months

key_safety: Most common (> 20%) adverse reactions: diarrhea (53%), hepatotoxicity (27%), rash (27%), fatigue (22%), nausea (21%). Serious adverse reactions in 34%; fatal reactions in 1% (due to pneumonia). Warnings: hepatotoxicity, left ventricular dysfunction, ILD/pneumonitis.
target_moa: Small molecule kinase inhibitor of HER2 (ERBB2); inhibits HER2 phosphorylation and downstream signaling and proliferation of lung cancer cells harboring HER2 TKD activating mutations

rems.type: No REMS required; safety concerns adequately addressed in labeling

companion_dx_detail: Patient selection requires HER2 (ERBB2) TKD activating mutations detected by an FDA-approved test; enrollment in Beamion LUNG-1 was based on prospective local testing, with the Oncomine Dx Target Test used only for retrospective testing of 52% (37/71) of samples

advisory_committee.vote: FDA did not refer this application to an advisory committee as no significant efficacy or safety issues required external input

description.text: Added accelerated approval for adults with unresectable or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC with HER2 (ERBB2) tyrosine kinase domain activating mutations

citations.quote: This “Prior Approval” sNDA provides for zongertinib for the treatment of adult patients with unresectable or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) whose tumors have HER2 (ERBB2) tyrosine kinase domain activating mutations as detected by an FDA-authorized test.

surrogate_endpoint.text: Objective response rate and duration of response; ORR considered an intermediate endpoint reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit in NSCLC

citations.quote: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on objective response rate and duration of response [see *Clinical Studies* (14)].
for NSCLC, ORR is considered an intermediate endpoint reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit.

confirmatory_requirement.text: Study 1479-0008 (Beamion LUNG-2), an open-label, randomized, controlled study of zongertinib vs pembrolizumab plus platinum-based doublet chemotherapy in previously untreated HER2 TKD mutant NSCLC, with PFS as the primary endpoint

citations.quote: Complete the ongoing multicenter, randomized clinical trial, Study Beamion LUNG-2, intended to verify and describe the clinical benefit of zongertinib in adult patients with advanced, unresectable or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer whose tumors have HER2 (ERBB2) tyrosine kinase domain activating mutations.

zongertinib is Study 1479-0008 (Beamion LUNG-2), an open-label, randomized, controlled, global study of zongertinib versus standard of care pembrolizumab plus platinum-based doublet chemotherapy in patients with previously untreated, unresectable locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC harboring HER2 TKD mutations. The primary efficacy endpoint is progression-free survival (PFS) per RECI

summary.text: Zongertinib received Fast Track (2023) and Breakthrough Therapy (2024) designations, was reviewed under Priority review via the RTOR program, and was granted accelerated approval based on ORR and DOR, with Beamion LUNG-2 required as the confirmatory trial.

requirement.text: 4881-2 Conduct a clinical drug-drug interaction study to evaluate the effects of a moderate CYP3A inducer on the pharmacokinetics of zongertinib. Collect pharmacokinetic information for zongertinib and utilize this information to determine the appropriate dose of zongertinib when co-administered with CYP3A inducers.
